assessment.behaviour_change: EditorComponent.submitForm used to always call articleService.create, which sent POST. Now it reads the route slug. With a slug it calls articleService.update (PUT /api/articles/:slug), and without one it calls create (POST). Creating an article behaves as before. Editing an existing article is the real change.
